author: GamingBolt
description:
Myst has returned in a new iteration that brings a lot of visual improvements while retaining the familiar gameplay loop that once had the entire gaming world under its spell. The island of Myst is as mysterious as ever, but can this one manage to hold the attention of a very discerning modern audience?

That's what we're here to explore as we dive into a review of a game that has often cropped up in conversations about modern gaming's greatest. Join us and see if this one's worth its asking price, and, equally important, your time.
title: Myst Remake PS5 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
If you’ve dived into First Light already, you might have noticed that the combat system shares a few common factors with Rocksteady’s excellent one in its Arkham franchise. But it’s also so different in the way it presents Bond as a man without a suit of armor to bear the brunt of enemy attacks that hit hard and fast. Has IO managed to make things different enough for its combat system to stand on its own two feet?

The answer is a resounding yes, and we’re happy to tell you why we think that’s the case. Join us as we compare and contrast between two combat systems that look so close, but couldn’t be further apart in how they approach their protagonists.
title: 007 First Light’s Melee Combat Is The Brutal Bond Brawler We Never Expected

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert has changed the way we think about open worlds in many ways. While its exploration-focused gameplay loop is an obvious reason, its evolution from a rather janky release build into a polished open-world area is another area that’s mighty impressive, and is probably one that Bethesda Studios must keep an eye on as it works on Elder Scrolls 6.

Why is that the case? Well, we’ve got quite a few reasons to explain it all. Join us as we look at how Bethesda could take a leaf out of Crimson Desert’s manual on game updates, alongside areas where it still manages to retain the upper hand. It’s a balancing act that might deter even the best of studios, but we think that Bethesda is definitely up to the challenge as long as it is smart about it. Hit play to find out why.

title: Crimson Desert May Have Quietly Raised The Stakes For The Elder Scrolls 6
